main_text.p: 40 Percusit itaque Iosue omnem terram montanam, & Meridianam, & campestrem, & descensus aquas, & omnes reges earum: non reliquit superstitem: & omnem animam interfecit, quemadmodum praeceperat Iehoua Deus Israel.
41 Percusit itaque Iosue à Cades Barne vsque ad Asa, & vniuersam terram Gosen vsque Gibeon.
42 Cunctos vero reges istos, & terram eorum cepit Iosue simul: quia Iehoua Deus Israelis pugnabat pro Israele.
43 Inde reuersus est Iosue ac vniuersus Israel cum eo in castra in Gilgal.

29 Transsuit deinde.) Nunc describitur vrbium expugnatio, ex quibus conflatus fuerat exercitus, vbi Deus virtutem suam non minus quam in acie admirabilem reddidit: praesertim si celeritatem reputemus. Nam etsi nonnihil consternationis attulerant qui trepidi illuc refugerat ex praelio:

page.notes: Marginal manuscript annotations on the left and right edges are handwritten and were not transcribed. The printed marginal note beside the last paragraph is partly obscured; the foot note text is approximate. Words in the lower paragraph are partly illegible in places and may contain errors.
